$comment: wedi (tile-backer boards, waterproofing membranes and flush-to-floor shower elements, wedi GmbH) runs a TYPO3 site with product pages under /en/products/<system>/<family>/<product> (for example Fundo Plano, the flush-to-floor shower element with integrated point drainage). The product name is the h1.product-header__title, the description is the meta description and the image is og:image. wedi sells through distributors and trade accounts, so there is no price in the markup: price and availability are not configured and every product returns price.state unknown with a PRICE_MISSING warning; price_unit usd only keeps currency USD. The dimensions, drain options and order numbers are in tables the selectors cannot pair, so fetch.engine is default (APP_DEFAULT_ENGINE, ai-crawler-avalai on this instance): the LLM returns 16 specs (dimensions and order data; 2 unique names are used in the test), with the image and description, each checked against the page, at about 6,469+1,808 tokens per request. Engines tried on the sample on 2026-11-19: http: SUCCESS with title, image and description; browser: the same; ai-crawler-avalai: the same plus 16 specs. ai-crawler-avalai is selected because it returns the specs. Needs APP_AI_CRAWLER_ENABLED with an AvalAI key on the instance. Checked against the saved (curl) Fundo Plano page on 2026-11-19.
